rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody December 2025
rows.verified: The accredited release was published on 30 April 2026 and covers deaths to March 2026 and self-harm and assaults to December 2025.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: There were 352 deaths in prison custody in the 12 months ending March 2026, 12% fewer than the previous 12 months.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The custody-death rate decreased from 4.6 to 4.0 deaths per 1,000 prisoners.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: There were 67 self-inflicted deaths, 28% fewer than the previous 12 months.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The self-inflicted-death rate was 0.8 per 1,000 prisoners, down from 1.1.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: There were 202 deaths from natural causes, an 18% decrease from 246.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: Nine homicides were recorded in the 12 months to March 2026, compared with six in the previous year.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: Of 74 deaths classified as Other, 43 awaited further information and cause categories may be revised after inquests.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The latest quarter recorded 85 deaths, 9% fewer than the previous quarter.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: MOJ warns that quarterly death figures are volatile and may reflect seasonal effects.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: There were 72,753 self-harm incidents, a rate of 837 per 1,000 prisoners and 8% below the previous 12 months.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The latest quarter recorded 17,322 self-harm incidents, 7% fewer than the previous quarter, with the rate down 5%.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: 13,394 individuals self-harmed, a rate of 154 per 1,000 prisoners and 3.6% below the previous rate.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: Average self-harm incidents per individual decreased from 5.7 to 5.4.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The male-establishment self-harm rate decreased 8% to 631 incidents per 1,000 prisoners.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The female-establishment self-harm rate decreased 5% to 5,730 incidents per 1,000 prisoners and remained over nine times the male rate.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: Average incidents among women who self-harmed decreased from 18.8 to 17.1.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: There were 31,545 assault incidents in the 12 months to December 2025, 2.8% more than the previous year.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The assault rate increased 2.7% to 360 incidents per 1,000 prisoners.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: There were 3,484 serious assaults, up 2.9%, with a rate of 40 per 1,000 prisoners.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The latest quarter recorded 7,499 assaults, 8% fewer than the previous quarter.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The latest quarter recorded 830 serious assaults, 13% fewer than the previous quarter.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: There were 21,463 prisoner-on-prisoner assaults, a rate of 247 per 1,000 prisoners and 6% above the previous year.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody detailed bulletin
rows.verified: The prison population was about 0.7% lower than March 2025 but around 12% higher than April 2021, so incident counts require population context.

rows.source: MOJ Safety in Custody collection
rows.verified: Deaths are published three months ahead of self-harm and assaults, so measures in one release refer to different ending periods.
